title: Lévy processes with partially stochastic resetting
summary: In this paper, we solve exit problems for a Lévy process that resets proportionally to its current position at independent Poisson epochs times. This resetting causes an additional (proportional to its current level) downward (upward) jump when the current position of the process is on the positive (negative) domain. Such a process can be expressed as an SDE, whose existence and uniqueness it discussed. All identities are given in terms of new family of scale functions.
